scope: counted k=4 Gaudry solver (gaudry_quartic, Macaulay degree 29-32, chains+sparsest), p=29, 2 curves with full 2-torsion, 12 main solves + 9 Amendment-A1 solves; research/lift_dense_conjugate_pair_decomp_20261106
statement: A k=4 decomposition solve on an all-lift conjugate-pair line costs the same as on F_p when it succeeds (conj/std 1.025, 0.982, 1.025 on shared targets; median over all solves 1.012; about 1.1e11 F_p multiplications at Macaulay degree 29). On one of the two curves the solver fails on both conjugate-pair targets that decompose: quotient dimension 4090 instead of 4096 at Macaulay degree 29, 30, 31 and 32, with 0 of 3 and 0 of 2 oracle decompositions found; the other curve's conjugate-pair targets, including a decomposable one, solve correctly at degrees 29-32.
